title.narrative: Denmark’s contribution to HURIDOCS’ project on strengthening accountability through digital investigations 2022-23

description.narrative:
The project aims to enhance accountability by strengthening the possibilities for safe, digital human rights investigations, specifically catered to the needs of human rights defenders, especially those in developing countries.
In the project, HURIDOCS will ensure the following key outputs: • Upgrade and improve Uwazi, their open source tool for human rights defenders • Train and on-board human rights defenders in the use of Uwazi • Do outreach-meetings with stakeholders.
Through a number of activities, including cross-sectors exchanges and public outreach events, HURIDOCS will engage with a broad range of actors, governments’ representatives, tech companies and academia to foster creation of broad-based alliances and an ecosystem of actors committed to explore, develop and support information and data management solutions for human rights.
